name: Address Poisoning Check
description: Before sending crypto, checks whether a recipient address is a lookalike of an address you trust (matching first/last characters) and whether its EIP-55 checksum is valid. Tools: check_recipient_lookalike (free) and onchain_check_info (explains the optional paid on-chain check of Ethereum/Base transfer history, 0.005 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
